sections.title: NMR Spectroscopy
sections.description: The course will focus on Essential Practical NMR for Chemistry. Topics will include structure elucidation with 1D and 2D NMR spectra, how to obtain high quality NMR spectra on spectrometers, data processing with NMR software such as MNova and TOPSPIN, multi-nuclei NMR including 31P, 19F, 11B, 15N and 2H etc., dynamic and kinetic NMR, and some techniques to provide high resolution 2D NMR spectra.
